tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas gtor mas las sgrub pa drug cu pa bzhugs

so// bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan zhing zla gsang gzhi bsnyen la drod thob pa'i sngags pas/ yang zlog me'i spu gri'i srung zlog bsad gsum mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa pū ri dkar nag gi bca' gzhi rgyas pa ma grub pa'i tshe'am/ de lta bu'i long med pa'i tshe gtor ma la brten nas dgra bgegs gzhom pa ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa 'jigs shing ya nga ba'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal nag po gri khrag gis byugs pa'i dbus su lcags ri gru bzhi pa zheng sor bzhi tsam dmar po'i dbus su phyogs lho'am/ gang du gtor ma gtong ba'i phyogs su rtse mo bstan pa'i chos 'byung nag po'i lte bar zlum skor gnyis pa'i ling tshe brgyad pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar nag gi lte bar 'bru'i tshom bu lnga/ ling tshe brgyad ser po byas pa'i shar gyi ling tsher dbang po dang nye dbang gi tshom bu gnyis/ de dag gi rgyab tu steng gi nyi ma dang zla ba tshangs pa'i tshom bu gsum/ nub tu chu lha'i tshom bu gcig dang*/ de'i rgyab tu sa'i lha dang thags bzang ris kyi tshom bu gnyis/ byang du gnod sbyin dang tshogs bdag gi tshom bu gnyis/ ling tshe gzhan rnams su tshom bu re re/ zla gam gsum ser po byas pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i steng sla nga'i nang du lcags mkhar rgyas par/ lte bar brub khung gcig dang*/ de dag gi logs gsum du brub khung bzhi bzhi ste bcu gsum pa rgyal po'i mkhar lta bu/ 'bring por dbus su brub khung gcig dang*/ de dag gi logs gsum du brub khung gnyis re ste bdun pa phyi'i zur dgu pa btsun mo'i mkhar lta bu/ bsdus par dbus su brub khung gcig pa phyi'i zur drug pa blon po'i mkhar lta bu| shin tu bsdus pa ni gtor chen zur gsum pa kho na'o// lcags mkhar gnyis po gang byed kyang dgra bgegs kyi ming rus dri ma drug gis sbags pa'i liṅga re re brub khung re re'i mthil du gan rkyal du bzhag

/lcags mkhar rgyas pa'i lugs byed na/ dbus kyi brub khung rim gcig gis mtho bar bya/ de dag gi phyi nang thams cad dug khrag dang rdo sol ro sol bsres pa dmar nag tu byug /zur gyi steng rnams su g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan/ mi ro'i gañdzi ra/ thod skam gyi mda' yab/ rgyu ma'i lda ldi bya/ zur ldebs rnams su yungs kar dang*/ mtshe dang*/ rtsang gis brgyan/ phyi rol tu lcags ri nag por rtsang srin mo'i 'gros su btsugs/ sha khrag gis brgyan par bya'o// nye logs su 'das pa'i gtor ma zur gsum bra nag gi dbyibs lta bu 'khor bzhi dang bcas pa/ gtor ma gtso bo'i steng du dar gdugs nag po phub/ sgrub pa yun ring byed na gtso 'khor so so'i tsaka li yang gzug go// lcags mkhar gyi dbus kyi brub khung gi khar yang ran pa zhig bcos pa sgrub pa'i ring logs su bzhag nas/ 'phen dus gtor ma gtso 'khor brub khung dbus ma'i kha gcod kyi tshul du steng du bzhag /lcags mkhar rgyas pa yin na brub khung gzhan drug po zan leb gru gsum pa re res kha bkab la 'phang*/ gtor ma dang lcags mkhar la zlog bsad kyi sngags mang du btab pa'i thun gyis brgyan pa shin tu gal che ba yin no// de dag gi mdun du thod pa'i lcags snod du las gshin gyi gtor ma zur gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang*/ mdun du khrag chen gyi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po'i me tog /sha chen dang gu gul sbyar ba'i bdug pa/ tshil chen dang mar nag gi snang gsal/ chang dang mkhris chen sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bru nag gi lha bshos zur gsum sha khrag gis sbags pa/ rkang gling gi rol mo rnams bshams/ sman raka/ rdor dril/ thod rnga/ rkang gling*/ rol mo rnams dang*/ 'dzom na lha gtso 'khor gyi phyag mtshan/ thun phur/ gri lcags/ ma 'dzom na zlog bsad kyi sngags btab ba'i thun rdzas dang phur pa rnam gsum/ mi bsad mtshon cha sna tshogs 'du bya/ dgra la byed na de dag gi dri ma drug dang*|

bgegs la byed na gnod byed de gnas pa'i sa chu shing sogs la rgyu byas pa'i liṅga la snying gar ming rus sogs bris pa'i liṅga dug khrag gis byugs pa/ tsha ba gsum gyis sbags pa sha dum re dang sbrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'ang bsham/ dmigs bya yod na de'i dri ma drug gang rung zhig med na 'byams par 'gyur bas shin tu gal che'o// yang ltas ngan dang rmi lam ngan pa sogs la byed na'ang gang byung de'i gzugs kyi rnam pa liṅga drug cu rtsa bzhi bya'o// de nas rang kha lhor phyogs pas skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang*/ cha gsum dang sman rag gtor ma phyi nang byin rlabs rnams dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar bya/ bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar byas rjes/ zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi dmigs pa ltar ram/ dbang chog gi bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i skabs ltar dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i sngags gsum po gang rung stong phrag yan chad smra ba bcad de bzla ba gal che ste rang nyid nus pa gso ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ oṃ kā la rū pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gshin rje'i lcags mkhar nag po zur bco lnga pa la brub khung bcu gsum dang ldan pa zhes sam/ zur dgu pa brub khung bdun dang ldan pa zhes sam/ zur drug pa brub khung gcig dang ldan pa zhes sam/ de gsum gang yin yang thun mong du/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa dang ldan pa'i bru+ub khung nang du dgra bgegs dngos su gcer bu gan rkyal yan lag lcags sgrog tu bcug pa re re gnas pa/ lcags mkhar chen po'i phyi nang steng thog thams cad du las kyi gshin rje dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa gnas shing rgyu ba/ sod rgyob chings zhes pa'i sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ gsod gcod kyi las la 'bad cing sha khrag srog dbugs la longs spyod pa/

'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ phyi nang thams cad du gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs shing zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa ltar gnam lcags chen po de dag gi steng gi bar snang drag po chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams chen po'i dbus su ya ma ti ra baṃ zhes pa gshin rje pho mo'i gdan zhes pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don ltar la rang nyid ces pa dang*/ rang tshe bdag tu gsal ba zhes pa dor/ bsnyen mtshams su sngags gsum gang 'grub bzla zhing khyad par du skabs 'dir gtso cher du ya ma bcu bdun pa bzla ba gal che'o// de nas las gshin dang phyogs skyong bco lnga bskyed pa ni/ rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las kyi gshin rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa spros pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams nas phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i snying nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings nas rang dbang med par bkug /oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dza dza dzaḥ de dag skad cig gis bkug ste phyogs mtshams su 'khod pa ni/ shar du dbang po ser po mig stong dang ldan pa glang chen la zhon pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ de'i g.yon du nye dbang nag po mkha' lding la zhon pa/ g.yas be con dang 'khor lo/ g.yon dung dang nor bu kau sū bha/ lhor gshin rje nag po ma he la zhon pa/ g.yas dbyug pa/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ nub tu chu lha dkar po sbrul la zhon pa/ sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du lus ngan ser po gter la gnas pa/ g.yas bi dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon ne'u le/ de'i g.yon du tshogs bdag glang sna dkar po byi ba la zhon pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang dgra sta/ g.yon la phug dang la du/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang po che la zhon pa/ g.yas rtse gsum/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ gau rī ma la 'khyud pa/

shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs/ srin por srin po sngon po ro langs la zhon pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ rlung du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la zhon pa/ lag gnyis rlung gi ba dan/ steng du nyi ma dmar po rta bdun la zhon pa pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba dkar po ku mu ta la gnas pa pad+ma 'dzin pa/ tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi pa ngang pa la zhon pa/ g.yas spyi blugs g.yon bgrang phreng*/ 'og tu sa lha ser po pad+ma la gnas pa/ g.yas khas len gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon bum pa| thags bzang ris sngon po shing rta la zhon pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon sdigs mdzub can/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi cha lugs can rang rang gi 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor nas yongs su 'khod par gyur par bsam/ slar yang rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje'i tho ba dang*/ g.yon phur bu bsnams pa'i phur bu phyogs skyong bcu'i spyi bor btab cing rdo rje'i tho bas brdung bar bsam/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ādz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ga ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngags gsum bzla/ de ltar phur bu btab cing brdungs pas phyogs skyong rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug ma thag /grub pa'i dngul chu lcags las byung ba ji lta bar phyogs skyong bco lnga skad cig gis gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nag po zhal gcig /spyan gsum gdangs shing*/ zhal bsgrad/ ljags 'dril/ khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa| dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang dpal gyi chas brgyad phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/

g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ma he pad+ma nyi zla gshin rje dregs byed pho mo'i gdan re rer 'khod pa/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje nag po g.yas be con 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub dgra bgegs kyi don snying 'drad pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ro'i gdan la 'khod pa/ de dag thams cad kyi dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams las 'od 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan| dbang gi lha rnams dang sngar spros pa'i pho nya rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ ya ma bcu bdun pa ci 'grub bzla ba ni sgrub pa'i rim pa'o// tshogs 'khor byed na skabs 'dir kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo ltar tshogs kyi bstab pa yan grub par byas la/ mched lcam rnams tshogs la longs spyod pa dang tshogs ni drug cu pa'i rjes su bya'o// de nas drug cu pa dngos ni liṅga rnams mdun du bkram la gser skyems bshams nas thog mar mkhyen dgongs dpang gzu dang dmod bcol bya'o// de nas brub khung bskyed chog byas nas gshin rje'i gzu dpang dang*/ byad ma rang gshed du bskor ba/ kiṃ kang gi bla 'gugs rnams byas rjes/ bla phur bstan la bla 'gugs sngags ci 'grub bzla/

de'i rjes snying phur bstan nas snying dbyung ba'i sngags ci 'grub bzla/ slar srog 'gugs pa sogs sngags byang snye ma dkar po'i 'gugs sngags rnams dang lha dbye'i sngags ci 'grub bzla/ de nas nyes byas drag bskul dang*/ so brdebs kyi dregs pa bskul/ byang chub lam bstan bya/ phur gdab gud bkol ltar byas nas dgra gzugs rnams gri lcags kyis gtub cing btun brdung byas la gzugs kyi gya ma zhig tsam bya'o// de nas 'bul ba ni/ rgyas par liṅga re re la 'bul thebs re bya/ 'bring du liṅga drug re 'bul thebs re bya/ bsdus na liṅga bcu re la 'bul thebs re bya/ shin tu bsdus na liṅga drug cu re la 'bul thebs re bya'o// de ltar rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang 'bul thebs gcig gi liṅga thod pa'i nang du mdun du bshams/ sran ma'i chan dang sman raka bran nas drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sras sprul las kyi gshin rje phyogs skyong bco lnga la phog pas 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ ma 'das pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rwa rnam par gdengs pa'i rnam pa sbu gu can gyis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa drangs te/ zhal du gsol bas mnyes shing tshims nas/ drag po mngon spyod kyi phrin las ma lus pa myur du sgrub par gyur par dmigs nas/ rdor thal kha bye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī kro dha ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza oṃ bhū tsā ra ṇaṃ/ mā pa tā la tsā ra ya/ mnā khe tsā ra ya/ ta purba ni gā naṃ/ ka dak+ṣi ṇa di ga ya hūm̐ pañtsi ma naṃ/ phaṭa ut+ta ra ti ga ya/ oṃ i/ hrīḥya/ ṣ+ṭi wa/ wik+ṣi/ kri ko tā e/ na a/ na do/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra ma hā maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/

bo dhi tsit+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā ba liṃ i maṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha hā/ hi hī/ huṃ hūm̐/ ho hau/ pheṃ pheṃ/ sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces liṅga re re nas 'bul na sngags tshar re re/ drug sdeb du 'bul na 'bul thebs re la sngags tshar drug re sogs liṅga'i grangs dang sngags grangs mnyam par lcags mkhar brub khung rnams su cha snyoms la 'bul/ 'bul thebs re re'i mthar/ na mo bla ma lan re thal mo gsum re brdab/ de'i mthar/ dgra bgegs gdug pa bdud kyi tshogs// zhes pa nas/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i bar 'dod gsol dang*/ skabs don gang yin gyi 'dod gsol phrin bcol re re bya ba shin tu gal che'o// gong gi sngags kyi ha hā zhes pa'i skabs lha rnams mnyes shing tshims nas bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs sgrog /pheṃ pheṃ zhes pa'i tshe mgron rnams mnyes shing dbang du bsdus nas phrin las gang bcol thogs med du mdzad par bsam mo// de ltar rgyas bsdus gang yin yang liṅga rnams phul zin nas/ drag po'i rnga sgra dang bcas pas 'di skad do// e/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi// rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sogs// mchod rdzas ji snyed yod pa rnams| |bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras sprul pho nyar bcas// las gshin phyogs skyong bco lnga sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs la 'bul// dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba sogs// gang 'dod las kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ru dhī ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ e/ stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi// dmar chen khrag gi zhabs bsil dang*// mchod rdzas ji snyed yod pa rnams// bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras sprul pho nyar bcas// las gshin phyogs skyong bco lnga sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs la 'bul// dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba sogs// gang 'dod las kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ru dhī ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pit+ta su ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

dza da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa riwā ra ma hā sh+ma shān shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sbyar ba dang*/ keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan// g.yang gzhi bla bre nam mkha'i rgyan// rgyu rlon lda las gshin phyogs skyong bco lnga sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs la 'bul// dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba sogs| |gang 'dod las kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ a laṅkā ra dpa' bo grir shi'i snying khrag dang*// srog chags du ma'i rak+ta la// rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum rab sbyar ba'i// dpal chen dregs pa'i btung ba mchog |'ben chen gsang ba'i rak+ta 'di// bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras sprul pho nyar bcas// las gshin phyogs skyong bco lnga sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs la 'bul// dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba sogs// gang 'dod las kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā ru dhī ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐| 'bru sna lnga dang dug khrag gis/ /sbrus pa'i dmar chen gtor ma la// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus par bcas// 'dod yon rnam lnga'i ba liṃ 'di// bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras sprul pho nyar bcas// las gshin phyogs skyong bco lnga sogs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs la 'bul// dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba sogs// gang 'dod las kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā ba liṃ pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul/ skabs 'dir bskang bshags dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo yang bya/ gru gsum mthing nag mas bstod/ de nas tshogs la longs spyad nas lhag gtor yang gtang*/ zhag mang po sbrel nas thun drug gam bzhir bcad la sngags bzla zhing bstod bskul bya/ dgong thun nam/ srod thun la drug cu pa bya'o// nub tha mar 'phang ba'i tshe sgrub khang steng du gser skyems dang gtor zor yang zlog gzhung ltar bya/ nang du 'ongs nas 'das gtor gtso 'khor lnga po lcags mkhar gyi bru+ub khung dbus su mañdzi'i khar bzhag la bstod ring gis bskul nas phyir spags/ zlog byang gyer nas dgug gzhug gsum sogs kyi rjes su drag bskul bya ste/ las gshin gyi gtor mas sna drangs/ rol mo/ go mtshon/ dur khrod kyi yo byad du ma dang bcas pa khyer te/ dmigs bya'i phyogs sam/

thebs thog gam/ lho phyogs sam/ grong zad pa'i mtha'i bzhi mdo'am/ dmigs bya yod na lha 'dre drag po gnas pa'i sa la sogs par 'phang ngo*// 'phen pa'i tshe dgra bgegs bsad par 'dod na lcags mkhar de nyid gnam lcags kyi rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa rwa gdengs pa ri rab tsam du gsal ba'i rwa sprag rnams su gshin rje phyogs skyong dregs pa'i dmag tshogs sa ya dung phyur gyis gang zhing*/ rwa rtse rnams nas thog dang ser ba nad mtshon drag po'i char bab pa dgra bgegs kyi steng du song nas kho'i snying nang du pho brang btab/ dbang byas sha zos khrag 'thung yul khams thams cad thal bar brlag par bsam/ gzhan yang thugs dam bskangs la 'dod yon du dmigs/ rang ngam yon bdag gi 'chi ba bslu na/ glud du dmigs la lhor btang*/ de la sogs pa'i las gang sgrub kyang ting nge 'dzin gyis kha bsgyur| gtor ma ni me'am chur 'phang*/ bsad zlog yin na gtor ma 'phangs pa'i rjes su bris sku phyar dar brdab/ ral pa sprugs/ thal mo brdab/ brang rdung 'o dod 'bod/ kho'i nyes pa bsgrags/ rbod gtong drag po'i zor 'phen pa'i sngags bsdebs dang bcas pa zlog bsad kyi sngags bzla'o// de rjes gtor mnan sogs yang zlog gi lag len dkyus ltar bya/ nang du log nas mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bsngo smon sogs byin chags par bya'o// 'di dag kyang gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud gyi le'u bcu gnyis pa dang*/ dmar po'i rgyud kyi le'u bcu bzhi pa sogs nas/ nyin re'i zla ba so so 'am/ yang na lo ni re re la/ dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi sbyin// zhes so// de'ang zhag gcig la thun tshod brgyad/ thun tshod re la 'pho ba gnyis re/ 'pho ba re la sa chu me rlung gi dbyug gu bzhi re yod pas drug cu rtsa bzhi yin la/ de dag gi sa chu'i dbyug gu la dge ba'i las dang*/ me rlung gi dbyug gu la mi dge ba'i las bya bar bsngags so// de la gtor ma sbyin pa'i tshul ni/

gshed dmar gyi rgyud kyi le'u bcu gnyis par/ de nas 'byung po thams cad kyi// gtor ma bya bar sngags rab bshad// sngags chen brjod par gyur pa na// 'byung po thams cad rab tu 'dar// hrīḥṣ+ṭī sogs sngags sa bon gang*// swā hā'i mtha' yi nges par sbyar/ */ zhes phyogs skyong gi sngags hrīḥṣ+ṭī dang spel ba sogs rgyas par gsungs so// de ltar drug cu pa'i gtor ma lcags mkhar dang bcas pa 'di gshin rje tshe bdag la'ang sbyor du rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'jigs byed kyi rtsa rgyud rtogs bdun dang*/ bshad rgyud rtogs gsum gnyis kar drug cu pa'i zhal ma gsungs kyang*/ dgra nag dang gshed dmar gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'jigs byed la sbyar te dmar nag 'jigs gsum ga ngo bo 'jam dpal dbyangs su gcig pa'i rig pas grub pa yin no// de'i phyir tshe bdag kyang ngo bo 'jam dpal dbyangs su gcig pa'i phyir 'dir yang sbyor du mi rung ba gtan nas ma yin pa nyid do// de ltar srung zlog bsad pa'i bca' gzhi dang sgrub pa rgyas pa ma grub pa'i tshe/ gtor ma la brten pa 'dis ni las rab 'byams nyid 'grub par 'gyur gyi/ drag las gtso bor mi 'don par zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi las sgrub na ni liṅga drug cu rtsa bzhi'i tshab tu zan gru gsum pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'am/ gtor chung drug cu rtsa bzhi sha khrag dang 'bru chen gyis sbags pa dag bya ste/ de dag gi 'bul lugs ni mkhyen dgongs nas btun rdung gi bar sogs drag las rnams bya mi dgos shing*/ 'jam gsum gyi kha bsgyur 'dogs dgos pas zhib cha zhal la dri dgos pa yod do// zhes pa'ang gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa lo paṇa mkhas grub kyis bkral ba'i yig cha la zhib cha ru dpyad de/ yang zlog me'i spu gri'i cha lag tsam du mi rung ba ma yin par mthong nas/ 'bri gung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas/
